beer.beer_description: Locked In is a brand new Range-style IPA loaded up with Motueka, Nelson Sauvin, Citra and Manilita. We love our kiwi hops - especially the newer varieties we have access to from Freestyle Hops. This one is everything we'd hoped, super hazy, super soft and super juicy. It pours a light yellow colour, with superior haze and a fluffy as heck foam. On the nose - this one is all tropical - wafts og guava lychee and white peach come streaming out and softly stick to your nostrils. From the first sip, you'll get oozing notes of pine lime splice, fresh lychee, ripe mango and peach gummies. Unbelievably soft and crushable! We're absolutely Locked IN with this one.

Whether you call it hazy, murky, blurry, or New England style, let’s raise our glasses to these heavenly hoppy ales!
